breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Use the standard non-isentropic normal shock equations,' directly correcting the original error of treating the shock as isentropic. It does not assume constant stagnation pressure across the shock, aligning with the ground truth that stagnation pressure decreases across the shock.
